description: The two middle values, which are not the same kind of thing. unprivileged_bpf_disabled = 2 refuses unprivileged bpf() exactly as 1 does and merely leaves the setting raisable, so it passes with a note rather than failing — failing it would be a finding against a host that is not exposed. bpf_jit_harden = 1 blinds constants for unprivileged programs only, which is precisely the case that stops mattering once an attacker has privilege, so it fails.
